The solution · live capabilities first
Verify first, then advertise
01 · Track (Built · Sandbox Relay)
Meta Pixel + Conversions API, deduplicated & verified
Coldie checks for duplicate theme pixels, enforces shared browser+server event_id, and holds Purchase as ‘not observed’ until a real order fires.
02 · Listen & Tear Down (Live in Prod · ₹1.32–₹5.14/run)
Live Reddit/X/IG buyer threads + Meta Ad Library rivals
Scrapes live category ads via Apify and verifies Reddit/X threads via Arctic Shift & oEmbed to find the exact claim competitors miss.
03 · Launch & Guard (Live Studio · ₹0.28/draft, ₹0.10/image)
Claim-guarded copy, FLUX visuals & guarded approvals
Gemini 3.7 Flash writes ads & posts, deterministic claims.js strips fake reviews/stats, and FLUX generates visuals on Cloudflare Workers AI.
Live at coldstart-swart-chi.vercel.app · Sibling ad engine at metacrok.vercel.app
03 / 12
The product · live store & brand intake
Onboarding that does the work
01 · Live Scan (19–22s · ₹0.98 / scan)
Reads Shopify /products.json (up to 60 SKUs), scrapes site copy, hex palette & fonts via Firecrawl v2, and checks public Instagram metadata.
02 · Play MetaCroc While It Works
An interactive pixel runner keeps the founder engaged while live API calls complete; progress caps at 94% until real data returns.
03 · Grounded Launch Kit Out
Outputs a real product shelf, 3 evidence-cited ICP cards, and a locked brand book that hands off directly into the Coldstart workspace.
Live in production: verified on Allbirds & GoMacro (24 real SKUs each in ~20s).

Meta ad prices rose +14% YoY in Q3 2026 (India D2C CACs +60–110%), while Gemini Flash-Lite + Firecrawl + Apify dropped full teardown cost to ₹4.26.

Earlier than the rest

Clean signal + grounded creative make every rupee of ad spend work harder.
